description: MetaCopper is a premium architectural copper finish panels designed for modern facades, elevations, and interior accents. Inspired by natural aged copper tones, it delivers a warm, luxurious appearance with long-lasting durability and corrosion resistance. Ideal for commercial buildings, villas, and designer projects, MetaCopper offers a low-maintenance copper cladding solution that blends contemporary design with timeless material elegance for modern architectural projects
